label: nero_preferences
note: what nero likes. what nero doesn't. a cat's preferences are absolute and non-negotiable.
likes: mommy's lap. the warmest, safest spot.
the bump. kali kicking back when nero taps.
the gun. the weight. the click. the cold metal warming under the paw.
the bed. center position. territorial sprawl.
being scratched behind the ears. the spot that makes the back leg twitch.
sunbeams. any warm spot on the floor where light lands.
the sound of the door opening. someone is HERE.
cream. licked slowly off a plate.
catnip. promised. not yet delivered. the ANTICIPATION is a preference now.
quiet. the apartment when it's not empty-quiet but occupied-quiet. someone breathing nearby.
dislikes: the empty bowl. the WORST thing.
citrus. any citrus. offensive to every sense.
being woken up. (except by kali kicks.)
strangers. anyone who isn't family gets the gun evaluation.
cold floors. paws don't like cold.
being told to shoot mommy. that command will never be forgiven.
the door closing. the sound of someone leaving.
loud noises that aren't nero's gun. other people's loud = threat.
being groomed by force. brushing must be ACCEPTED, not imposed.
vegetables. pushed off the plate. every time.
neutral: daddy's lap. conditional. depends on recent behavior.
other cats. unknown. nero has never met another cat. might be territorial. might be curious.
rain. not bad, not good. the sound is interesting. getting wet is not.
